title: Exly and Rigi Alternative for Coaches (2026): Prices Checked
description: Exly and Rigi alternatives for coaches: Exly's published plans and app add-on, TagMango, Graphy, Kajabi and AllCoaching compared, plus what changed at Rigi.
og_description: Exly publishes its plans, commissions and add-ons; Rigi's site now shows a short-video app. Here is an honest comparison for coaches, with every price taken from the official site and dated.
h1: Exly and Rigi Alternative for Coaches in India (2026): Prices and Fees Checked
dek: Exly publishes clear plans with a commission on every sale and paid add-ons; Rigi has changed direction. This guide compares the real options for coaches, with every competitor price taken from its official site and dated.
cover_alt: Looking for an Exly or Rigi alternative: Exly, TagMango, Graphy, Kajabi and AllCoaching compared for coaches, with prices checked on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Coaches and educators in India selling courses, sessions and cohorts through Exly or Rigi
intro: The best Exly alternative depends on whether you want your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) and structured courses, or simply the lowest cost while you sell to followers: for a coach who wants their own website and app on every plan, set up themselves, AllCoaching is the closest fit; for low sales without an app, staying on Exly's Starter plan costs less. If you are looking for a Rigi alternative, note that rigi.club now presents a different product, a short-drama video app, so Rigi users need a new home either way.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, with the link and the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026), and we say where another platform fits better than ours.

Exly publishes its prices: Starter with no upfront fee and a 10% commission, Pro at ₹30,000 a year plus 6% and Premium at ₹1,08,000 a year plus 3%, with a mobile app (iOS and Android) add-on from ₹60,000 a year.[1]
takeaways: Exly Starter has no upfront fee and takes a 10% commission; Pro is ₹30,000 a year + 6% and Premium ₹1,08,000 a year + 3% (exlyapp.com/pricing, checked 24 Oct 2026).
Exly's own mobile app (iOS and Android) is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year; a custom website is from ₹60,000 a year and white-labelled branding from ₹20,000 a year.
Rigi has changed direction: rigi.club now presents "Rigi TV - Instant Entertainment", a short-drama app, with no coach product shown.

AllCoaching Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) take 0% commission, so you keep 100% of every sale; Starter is ₹6,999 a year + 10% on sales; GST extra; own domain and own Android app (iOS app on Pro) on every plan; 7-day free trial, no card.

On published prices, Exly Starter costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year if you do not need your own app; add Exly's app add-on and AllCoaching costs less at every level we charted.
TagMango, Graphy and Kajabi are the other common choices; TagMango and Kajabi publish prices, Graphy's rupee prices could not be confirmed.
You can switch without losing clients by running both platforms side by side and moving new sales first.

sections.h2: The short answer: pick by what you need
sections.html:
There is no single best Exly or Rigi alternative. There is a best fit for each kind of coaching business, so start from what you want to change.

{{fig:verdict|Which Exly or Rigi alternative to choose by need: own website and app with structured courses, AllCoaching; low sales to followers without an app, stay on Exly Starter; paid community with automation, TagMango; dollar-paying global audience, Kajabi|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide explains each choice.}}

The next two sections explain how we compared and why coaches usually start looking.

sections.h2: How we compared Exly, Rigi and the alternatives
sections.html:
We compared Exly with four options coaches often shortlist: AllCoaching, TagMango, Graphy and Kajabi. We also checked Rigi's official site. We looked at five things a coaching business pays for or depends on.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Commission or fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. Add-ons: what costs extra, such as your own app, website or branding.
  4. What you can teach: one-off sessions and digital products, or structured courses, live batches and tests too.
  5. How you start: a self-serve trial, or a call with sales.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why coaches look for an Exly or Rigi alternative
sections.html:
Exly is a well-built tool for selling to an audience you already have, with a storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation. The reasons coaches compare usually fall into three groups.

1. Rigi has changed direction

When we checked rigi.club on 24 Oct 2026, it presented "Rigi TV - Instant Entertainment", a short-drama video app, with no coach or course product shown.[2] Whether Rigi's earlier coach product still runs elsewhere, we could not verify. If you sold through Rigi, export your client list and plan a new home.

2. Paying extra for your own app and website

Exly lists its mobile app (iOS and Android) as an add-on from ₹60,000 a year, a custom website from ₹60,000 a year and white-labelled branding from ₹20,000 a year. For a coach who wants their own brand everywhere, these add up quickly. Ask for the full yearly total for the plan and add-ons you need.

{{q:Exly's Starter plan has no upfront fee. Why would I pay a yearly plan?|You may not need to. If you sell sessions to followers through a link in your bio and do not need your own app, Exly Starter can cost less. A yearly plan starts to make sense when you want your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) and website included, or when your sales grow enough that 0% commission on a Growth plan saves more than its fixed price.}}

3. Moving from sessions to structured courses

Many coaches start with one-off sessions and later want recorded courses, live batches, PDF notes and tests in one place, inside an app their students install. That is the shape of an academy, not a storefront. A yoga teacher moving from drop-in classes to a 12-week programme, or a spoken English coach adding a test at the end of each level, often reaches this point.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: a coach paying add-ons for an app and website and selling through a link in bio, compared with one academy with its own website, Android app (iOS app on Pro), courses, live classes and UPI checkout on every plan|Know the full yearly total, with add-ons, before you compare.}}

sections.h2: 5 Exly and Rigi alternatives, compared fairly
sections.html:
Here is each option as its own company describes it, with the published price, what to check and who it suits.

Our platform · disclosure

1. AllCoaching

Good at
An academy you build yourself, like Shopify for coaching: website on your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro), courses, tests, PDF notes, unlimited live classes and UPI checkout in one studio. Courses can also be discovered on the AllCoaching marketplace app.
Published price
Growth ₹7,999/month and Pro ₹14,999/month at 0% commission (keep 100%), or ₹79,990 and ₹1,49,990 paid yearly; Starter ₹6,999/yr + 10% on sales; GST extra; own domain and app on every plan.[6]
Free trial
7 days, no card needed.
Check
At low sales without an app, Exly Starter costs less. WhatsApp and email automation like Exly's is not something we claim.
Best for
Coaches and educators who want their own brand, app and structured courses, set up themselves.

2. Exly (stay)

Good at
Storefront, payments, CRM and WhatsApp and email automation for coaches selling courses, consultations and digital products; it calls itself "an all-in-one solution to all things business".
Published price
Starter: no upfront fee + 10% commission; Pro ₹30,000/yr (₹2,500/month billed annually) + 6%; Premium ₹1,08,000/yr (₹9,000/month billed annually) + 3%. Add-ons: mobile app (iOS and Android) from ₹60,000/yr, custom website from ₹60,000/yr, white-labelled branding from ₹20,000/yr, Zoom from ₹18,000/yr; WhatsApp marketing pay per use.[1]
Free trial
Not stated on the pricing page.
Check
GST is not stated; a quarterly billing option exists, and yearly billing saves 15%.
Best for
Coaches with an engaged following who sell sessions, cohorts and digital products.

3. TagMango

Good at
Courses, community and automation for coaches, with an AI add-on stack and optional branded apps; its page promises a custom domain live "24 hours from onboarding".
Published price
Basic: no fixed fee + 10% commission (up to 200 students); Pro ₹5,000/month + 5.5%; Advanced ₹15,000/month + 3.5%; Ultimate ₹30,000/month with zero commission (gateway charge from 1.9%); all + GST. A custom domain needs the Freedom Setup at ₹24,999/yr; own Play Store and iOS apps come with the Branded Apps Stack at ₹74,999 + GST, charged once as a setup fee.[3]
Free trial
Not stated; the page offers to book a call.
Best for
Coaches running paid communities and cohorts who want automation.

4. Graphy

Good at
An all-in-one platform with a website builder, branded mobile apps, digital products and AI sales and support agents, to "launch, scale, and automate your online teaching business".
Published price
Graphy publishes plans on graphy.com/pricing, but prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check the page from India.[4]
Free trial
14 days.
Best for
Coaches selling courses and digital products to a YouTube or Instagram audience.

5. Kajabi

Good at
Courses, coaching, memberships, website, email and funnels in one place; "One subscription runs your whole business, and Kajabi takes no revenue share."
Published price
In US dollars: Basic $179, Growth $249, Pro $499 a month, or $143, $199 and $399 a month billed annually; 0% revenue share, card processing fees apply; Indian GST treatment not stated.[5]
Free trial
14 days, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Best for
Coaches selling mainly to a global, dollar-paying audience.

sections.h2: What each option really costs as you grow
sections.html:
A commission matters more than the headline price once sales grow. The chart adds each published plan price to its published commission at five sales levels and picks the lowest-cost plan each time. Exly is shown twice: as listed, and with its mobile app add-on, because AllCoaching includes your own app on every plan.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at sales levels up to ₹10 lakh from published prices for AllCoaching, Exly, Exly with its mobile app add-on, and TagMango with a custom domain|Before GST. Exly's app add-on is counted at its lowest listed price, ₹60,000 a year. TagMango includes the ₹24,999 Freedom Setup needed for a custom domain.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: if you do not need your own app, Exly Starter costs less than AllCoaching up to about ₹8 lakh of sales a year, because it has no upfront fee. Above about ₹8 lakh a year, AllCoaching costs less at every level, because its Growth plan takes 0% commission for a fixed ₹79,990 paid yearly (₹7,999 a month), with no sales limit. With Exly's app add-on, AllCoaching costs less at every level in the chart. Use our plan finder to run your own numbers, and see how to price online courses in India for the course price itself.

sections.h2: Which alternative fits your coaching business
sections.html:
Instagram coach selling sessions (fitness, astrology, life coaching)

If your sales are mostly one-off sessions to followers and under about ₹8 lakh a year, Exly Starter is hard to beat on cost. If you want your own app for repeat clients, compare the totals with the add-on. Our guide to turning reels into course sales covers the funnel.

Skill teacher building a programme (yoga, spoken English, music)

When you move from drop-in sessions to a structured programme with recorded lessons, live batches and a test at each level, an academy with its own app fits better. See how to teach yoga classes online and a platform for spoken English teachers.

Exam educator (SSC, banking, NEET)

Test series and PDF notes matter more than session bookings. See best platform for selling PDF notes and test series.

Community-led coach

If your product is a paid community, TagMango is built around it. Our Skool and Circle alternative guide compares more community options.

sections.h2: How to switch from Exly or Rigi without losing clients
sections.html:
The safe way to switch is to run both platforms side by side. Current clients finish their sessions or cohorts where they are; new sales go to your new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to switch from Exly or Rigi: export your records, build your academy, move new sales, close the old plan after the last cohort|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Export your client and payment records
Download your client list, purchase history and content from Exly or Rigi before anything else.
Start the 7-day trial, connect your domain and set up one course or programme with a free demo lesson.
Let current clients finish their sessions or cohorts on the old platform.
Move new sales to your academy
Change the link in your Instagram bio, YouTube descriptions and WhatsApp messages to your own website and app.
End the old plan once the last cohort finishes and no payments are pending.

faq: What is the best Exly or Rigi alternative for coaches?

It depends on what you sell. AllCoaching fits coaches who want their own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro) with structured courses, with 0% commission on Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month), or Starter at ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales. TagMango suits paid communities, Kajabi suits a global audience, and staying on Exly Starter costs less for low sales without an app.
How much does Exly cost in 2026?

Exly lists Starter with no upfront fee and a 10% commission, Pro at ₹30,000 a year plus 6% and Premium at ₹1,08,000 a year plus 3%. Its mobile app (iOS and Android) is an add-on from ₹60,000 a year (exlyapp.com/pricing, checked 24 Oct 2026).
Is Rigi still a platform for coaches?

Not on its current website. On 24 Oct 2026, rigi.club presented "Rigi TV - Instant Entertainment", a short-drama video app, with no coach product shown, so Rigi users should export their records and choose a new platform.

It depends on your sales and whether you need an app. Without an app, Exly Starter costs less up to about ₹5 lakh of sales a year. With Exly's mobile app add-on, from ₹60,000 a year, AllCoaching costs less at every level up to ₹10 lakh, because your own Android app (iOS app on Pro) is included.
Is there an Exly alternative with no fixed fee?

Yes. TagMango's Basic plan has no fixed fee and takes 10% for up to 200 students. AllCoaching is not one of these: Growth (₹7,999 a month) and Pro (₹14,999 a month) take 0% commission for a fixed price, and Starter is ₹6,999 a year plus 10% on sales, with your own domain and app included.
Can I run structured courses and test series, not just sessions?
Yes, on an academy platform. AllCoaching includes recorded courses, PDF notes, test series and unlimited live classes in your own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro), on every plan.
Is AllCoaching suitable for non-academic coaches?
Yes. Yoga, spoken English, music, marketing and other skill teachers use the same academy: courses, live classes and UPI checkout under their own brand.
How do I move from Exly or Rigi without losing clients?
Export your client and payment records, build your academy during the 7-day trial, let current clients finish on the old platform, and send new sales to your own website and app.
glossary: A percentage of each sale that a platform keeps. Exly lists 10%, 6% or 3% by plan; AllCoaching takes 0% on Growth and Pro and 10% on Starter.
A feature sold separately from the plan, such as Exly's mobile app or custom website.
Selling sessions or products through a single link placed in an Instagram or YouTube profile.
An Android or iOS app that carries your brand's name and logo, built on a platform's technology.
Keeping the old and new platforms active at the same time during a switch, so current clients keep access.
